title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Overview

About Sierra Studio

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

About our hiring partner

Our hiring partner is a consumer product development company. They help companies make new products & bring them to market, leading concepting, design, engineering, supply chain setup & ongoing operational oversight. They have teams in New York City, Hong Kong and beyond. They work with startups and established companies across many consumer categories; from connected hardware & electronics, to durable housewares and in-home goods, to soft-goods and packaging, and everything in between.

Who our hiring partner is looking for

They are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling, prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer will be a member of our hiring partner's Brazil team - The position can be remote but will report to the Staff Engineer out of Campinas/SP. The Brazil team reports into the Head of Product based in HQ in NYC.

The Candidate

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on challenges.

The Job

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

Responsibilities

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components. Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

The Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • High level proficiency in English language- written and spoken

Working Hours

While our work involves coordination predominantly with NY Team, there are meetings that are scheduled outside of traditional 9-6 working hours to accommodate the HK team. We trust all team members to manage their schedules and to take appropriate measures to take care of themselves and their wellbeing.

The Process

Please submit your resume and we will reach out if there is a potential fit.

Our hiring partner is constantly refining their hiring process to be as inclusive, transparent, and respectful of applicants' time as possible. As part of this process, you may be asked to complete a paid assessment based on the role.

Our hiring partner is an equal opportunity employer. They are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. They firmly believe that a diversity of experience, perspectives, and background lead to a better environment for their employees and to better results for their clients. They strongly encourage diverse candidates to apply.

Job Purpose

The Regulatory Compliance Analyst supports global compliance efforts by executing risk assessments, monitoring regulatory changes, maintaining internal controls, and contributing to training and cross-functional collaboration. The role ensures that Hedgepoint operates in full compliance with applicable laws, financial market regulations, and industry best practices across all jurisdictions.

Key Activities

Activities carried out with a global scope, covering Hedgepoint Group companies in Brazil, USA, Switzerland, Uruguay, Singapore, and Dubai, in accordance with the legal and regulatory requirements of each country and their respective financial market regulators.

Compliance and Regulatory Analysis:

  • Monitor and analyze applicable laws and regulations in the countries of operation.
  • Draft legal opinions and action plans for risk mitigation.
  • Conduct legal and regulatory risk assessments.
  • Perform compliance reviews and prepare regulatory reports.
  • Track and consolidate regulatory obligations across all areas, ensuring compliance within regulatory deadlines.
  • Create and review policies and procedures aligned with legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain client onboarding checklists addressing legal and regulatory obligations.
  • Create, review, and update suitability rules in accordance with the regulatory standards of all applicable countries.

Monitoring and Training:

  • Conduct compliance testing to ensure adherence to internal and external standards.
  • Develop, update, and deliver training on compliance and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide ongoing support regarding the interpretation of laws and regulations.

Collaboration and Reporting:

  • Respond to audits and requests from regulatory authorities.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, KPIs, and support compliance projects.
  • Work closely with business areas to integrate compliance into operational processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in law.
  • Proficiency in regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with risk assessment and internal controls, policies & procedures, Brazilian Central Bank, CVM, NFA/CFTC.
  • Microsoft Word (write), Excel (graphs and tables), PowerPoint (presentations), Adobe Pro, Power BI
  • Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese
  • Experience working in Broker Dealer (DTVM / CTVM) Compliance Departments
  • Tech/ AI innovations.

Campinas, SP - Up to twice a week at the base office (Hybrid)

Job description

Viver o mundo de eventos universitários é entender que o mercado é dinâmico e exige mudanças constantes. A única certeza que temos é que o nosso papel é deixar gente feliz, é sair do padrão, é questionar o óbvio! Achar estabilidade no que parece incerto ou balançar o que parece estável demais.

Seu papel como Analista Comercial na Formô Brasil será prospectar ativamente leads por meio de ativações nas faculdades e ações de relacionamento. Sua atuação abrange negociar e finalizar o funil de vendas, além de realizar o acompanhamento do pós-venda junto aos times envolvidos no projeto.

Aqui valorizamos o respeito, a diversidade e a inclusão. Portanto, não fazemos diferenciação de gênero, orientação sexual, raça ou religião. Esta oportunidade é afirmativa para mulheres, reforçando nosso compromisso em ampliar representatividade.


Main responsibilities

Requirements and skills

O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Disponibilidade para atuar em horários com base nas agendas dos eventos;

Diferenciais:

UM TIME APAIXONADO E COLABORATIVO Somos movidos pelo propósito de transformar vidas com a nossa energia levando mais conforto para as pessoas, mais eficiência para os negócios e desenvolvimento para as cidades. Quero evoluir com a gente? #vemsercomgás

  • Coordenar a operação e infraestrutura do Centro de Controle Operacional da Comgás, gerindo a equipe de despachos de notas e chamados de emergências, equipe de suporte a crises e operações na rede, equipe de sala de controle de ativos no monitoramento de variáveis essenciais, projetos estratégicos, bem como controlar ativos críticos da operação, garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento e segurança operacional, reportando incidentes, garantindo a continuidade do negócio e processos internos a fim de viabilizar o fornecimento seguro de gás para os clientes.
  • Coordenar a área planejando e estipulando prazos para o desenvolvimento de entrega dos trabalhos, distribuindo e priorizando as atividades da equipe, definindo cronograma para desenvolvimento das atividades e zelando pelo seu cumprimento, garantindo o andamento dos trabalhos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Coordenar o projeto de Gestão Eficiente de Serviço de Campo, aprimorando o sistema de mobilidade em todos os processos da empresa, incluindo gestão de emergência, manutenção, construção, expansão e cadastro afim de aumentar a eficiência das atividades, reduzindo prazos e custos, melhorando a qualidade e proporcionando uma experiência aprimorada para a equipe e clientes.
  • Liderar o projeto de Transformação Digital e Convergência com mais de 1200 ativos garantindo a segurança operacional, capturar dados de processos, renovar e ampliar o uso de telemetria e automação de ativos, aumentar a disponibilidade e conectividade dos dados para um monitoramento abrangente afim de proporcionar segurança, eficiência e retorno financeiro.

  • Monitorar o orçamento garantindo as metas e performance sem impactos à qualidade, segurança e avanços tecnológicos da área de projetos bem como acompanhar o encerramento das ordens e projetos, aprovar as medições a fim de garantir eficiência e governança aos recursos da organização.
  • Garantir a disponibilidade dos dados e o funcionamento consistente do sistema de distribuição, realizando simulações com o gás na rede afim de definir melhor estratégia operacional.
  • Manter a equipe em constante atualização e evolução técnica e comportamental, por meio de treinamentos, troca de experiências, feedbacks constantes, contratos de metas e plano de desenvolvimento, além de mantê-los em sintonia com as tecnologias disponíveis e alinhamento com a cultura organizacional, com objetivo de motivá-las, capacitá-las e orientá-las para o alcance das metas estabelecidas pela empresa.

  • Contribuir com a elaboração do programa orçamentário de custeio de sua área, bem como acompanhamento e controle dos dispêndios havidos e oportuna recomendação quanto à forma de correção dos desvios.
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir a legislação e regulamentação pertinentes à área de atuação e atividades sob sua responsabilidade, requisitos dos sistemas de gestão da qualidade e compliance bem como normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene, segurança do trabalho e utilização de EPI's/EPC's, quando a atividade assim o exigir.

  • Atuar em situações de emergência, tais como vazamento de gás, falta de gás e situações relacionadas, como coordenador da mesma, seja na tomada de decisão em sala de crise ou em ações e coordenações em campo, afim de mitigar e eliminar riscos.

  • Conhecimento de projetos, equipamentos de regulagem de pressão;
  • Conhecimento em atividades de reparo de rede (soldas em PE, equipamentos de içamento de cargas, de escoramento de valas).

Informações adicionais

  • BENEFÍCIOS QUE VOCÊ TERÁ: Cuidar da saúde é essencial, não é? Por isso, além do vale-refeição e alimentação para a comida gostosa do dia a dia, oferecemos assistência médica, odontológica, auxílio farmácia, auxílio óptico e seguro de vida. Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a Ambev Global Tech , hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. description:
Overview

Analytics Engineer (Mid-level) role at AB InBev. AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies, with over 500 beer brands and a strong presence across North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our B2B, direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group enables data-driven digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev worldwide. The Growth Group supports brands such as Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra and includes digital products like BEES, Ze Delivery, TaDa Delivery, and PerfectDraft. We are an exceptional team focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

We are looking for a skilled Analytics Engineer to design, deliver, and maintain high-quality data products that enable self-service analytics and support decision-making. This role involves transforming complex raw data into trusted, tested, and well-documented datasets and semantic models using modern data platforms such as Databricks and Power BI.

  • Develop and maintain tested, documented, and code-reviewed datasets and data models.

  • Build intuitive, high-performing dashboards in Power BI and Databricks.
  • Ensure data governance, privacy, and quality standards are met.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for data workflows and maintain reproducibility and version control.
  • Create clear documentation for all data solutions and stay updated with best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related fields.
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, PySpark, and SparkSQL. Experience with Azure Databricks and Power BI is highly desirable.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling and warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Experience delivering ad hoc analyses and building reusable data products.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Advanced or fluent English language skills.

Role Description

We are seeking a Construction Program Manager L1/L2 to support the DCD Area by carrying out on-site activities in the Hortolândia – Campinas area that ensure effective control of project execution. The ideal candidate will collaborate with clients, contractors, and internal teams to deliver mission-critical projects on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Schedule, chair, and record minutes of client and project meetings, keeping all teams informed.
  • Provide weekly reports on project scope, budget, schedule, and contract issues.
  • Liaise with clients, professional teams, and contractors to establish and monitor project processes.
  • Maintain and update the Project Risk Register, implementing and tracking mitigation plans.
  • Coordinate and monitor commissioning activities, ensuring plans, tests, and documentation are complete.
  • Oversee Practical Completion documentation, manuals, and handover activities.
  • Manage General Contractor deliverables, including schedules, RFIs, submittals, and O&M manuals.
  • Support integration planning and coordinate DC Operations’ involvement in installation, commissioning, and snagging.
  • Ensure compliance with site access, security, and operational processes during and post-turnover.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 3–5 years of experience in project management or similar responsibilities.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Electrical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Data Centers or Mission-Critical project experience preferably
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.
